# Subway Seat for Tabby

Colors, cursor and selection. Tabby's default minimum contrast ratio of 4 nudges some colors; set `terminal.minimumContrastRatio: 1` to see the palette as designed.

[Tabby](https://tabby.sh) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/tabby/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.yaml`](subway-seat.yaml) | `Tabby config.yaml, under terminal.customColorSchemes` |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.yaml`](subway-seat-tunnel.yaml) | `Tabby config.yaml, under terminal.customColorSchemes` |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.yaml`](subway-seat-enamel.yaml) | `Tabby config.yaml, under terminal.customColorSchemes` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Tabby's config.yaml (Settings › Config file), then Settings › Color scheme:

```yaml
terminal:
  customColorSchemes:
    - name: Subway Seat   # paste the whole entry from subway-seat.yaml
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Tabby's config.yaml (Settings › Config file), then Settings › Color scheme:

```yaml
terminal:
  customColorSchemes:
    - name: Subway Seat Tunnel   # paste the whole entry from subway-seat-tunnel.yaml
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Tabby's config.yaml (Settings › Config file), then Settings › Color scheme:

```yaml
terminal:
  customColorSchemes:
    - name: Subway Seat Enamel   # paste the whole entry from subway-seat-enamel.yaml
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `Tabby config.yaml, under terminal.customColorSchemes`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
